content.title: Connect Pages and Media
content.hook: A link tells the browser that a piece of content points to another location.
content.context: ```html View the curriculum ``` The text is what the user reads. The `href` attribute tells the browser where the link points.
goals: Create links and images with the required attributes and predict what the browser needs to use each resource.

content.question: In this element: ```html View the curriculum ``` What does `href` provide?

feedback.correct: `href` gives the browser the destination associated with the link.
feedback.incorrect: `href` gives the browser the destination associated with the link.

activities.title: An image is also a resource

content.title: An image is also a resource
content.text: An image element tells the browser about an image resource. ```html ``` For this lesson’s model: - `src` identifies the image resource. - `alt` provides a text alternative describing the image’s purpose or content.

content.question: A developer writes: ```html ``` What important information is missing for the browser to load the image resource?

feedback.correct: The browser needs the image source. `src` tells it which image resource to use.
feedback.incorrect: The browser needs the image source. `src` tells it which image resource to use.

options.text: A link uses `href` to identify its destination; an image uses `src` to identify its resource.

feedback.correct: Different elements need different attributes because they describe different jobs.
feedback.incorrect: Different elements need different attributes because they describe different jobs.

content.question:
You need:

1. A link to `/practice` with the words “Start practice”
2. An image from `forge.png` described as “Forge mark”

Which answer is correct?

feedback.correct: The attributes match the element’s job: `href` for the link destination, `src` for the image resource, and `alt` for the text alternative.
feedback.incorrect: The attributes match the element’s job: `href` for the link destination, `src` for the image resource, and `alt` for the text alternative.

content.title: Forge takeaway & Lesson completion
takeaways: **Mental model:** Elements can use attributes to carry extra information needed for their job.
**Senior habit:** When an element does not behave as expected, inspect its required attributes before rewriting everything around it.
nextSteps: Complete the lesson activities and demonstrate the target skill without relying on unseen concepts from later modules.
